new comment 5388097 (near Felszabadulás MTSZ, Picktelep, Szombathely) / Created 4 months ago by Mateusz Konieczny
https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/1024790371/history place=farm wiki page ( https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Tag:place=farm ) claims that it is solely for named farms. Is this tagged incorrectly? Is it named but name is missing from OSM? Is wiki wrong? / Updated 5 days ago by SzilágyiGyula
Hi Mateusz, Thanks for pointing this out! This location is actually a local agricultural cooperative site (TSZ / farmyard) known as Szombathelyi Felszabadulás Mgsz (Mezőgazdasági Szövetkezet). It is an active agricultural/industrial farm compound rather than a standalone named hamlet or named residential farm, so the place=farm tag without a name is indeed inappropriate here. Feel free to update it to landuse=farmyard (or building=farm_auxiliary) and add name=Szombathelyi Felszabadulás Mgsz. / Updated 5 days ago by Mateusz Konieczny
https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/548718420 farmyard area is present already / Updated 3 days ago by Mateusz Konieczny
"known as " so maybe old_name should be moved to name ? / Updated 3 days ago by SzilágyiGyula
Let me check personally. I'll be back soon with the correct answer.
